description: This file contains internal utilities and functions for exporting PyTorch models to ONNX, including type conversions, attribute compatibility checks, overload matching, and dispatching nodes to appropriate ONNX operations based on their schemas and types.

methods.name: ir.DataType _torch_dtype_to_onnx_compatible_dtype(dtype: torch.dtype)
methods.description: Converts a PyTorch dtype to its corresponding ONNX-compatible ir.DataType.

methods.name: bool _attribute_type_compatible_with_arg( attr: _schemas.AttributeParameter, value: ir.Value | int | float | bool | Sequence[int] | Sequence[float] | None, )
methods.description: Checks if a given attribute parameter is type-compatible with a provided value.

methods.name: bool _param_type_compatible_with_arg( param: _schemas.Parameter, value: ir.TypeProtocol | str | int | float | complex | Sequence[int] | Sequence[float] | None, assigned_types: dict[str, ir.TypeProtocol], )
methods.description: Checks if a parameter's type constraint is compatible with a given value or type.

methods.name: ir.TypeProtocol _get_type_from_tensor( tensor: torch.Tensor | torch.SymBool | torch.SymInt | torch.SymFloat | Sequence[torch.Tensor], )
methods.description: Returns the ir.TypeProtocol corresponding to a given tensor or symbolic variable.

methods.name: torch.Tensor|None _get_first_tensor_in_node_list( nodes: Sequence[torch.fx.Node | Any], )
methods.description: Extracts the first tensor from a list of FX nodes or other objects.

methods.name: dict[str,torch.fx.node.Argument] _get_named_fx_node_args(node: torch.fx.Node)
methods.description: Retrieves named arguments from an FX node based on its schema.

methods.name: tuple[Callable|None,str] get_matching_overload( node: torch.fx.Node, overloads: Sequence[_registration.OnnxDecompMeta], )
methods.description: Finds the appropriate overload for a given FX node from available signatures.

methods.name: tuple[Callable|None,str] dispatch( node: torch.fx.Node, registry: _registration.ONNXRegistry )
methods.description: Dispatches an FX node to the correct ONNX function based on registered decompositions and input types.
